events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: Impact of MTV
angles.copy: On this day in 1981, MTV blasted onto our screens, forever changing the music landscape. Did video really kill the radio star, or did it just give it a stylish new outfit?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring tracks like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Britpop classic
angles.copy: It's 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and kicked off a new era for British music. What's your favourite track from this absolute Britpop classic?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music and Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, attracting over 400,000 people to a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace, love & music
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a field for Woodstock. Three days of peace, love, and iconic music. Wish you were there?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' passed away on August 16, 1977, leaving an indelible mark on music and popular culture.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music lives on.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur died on September 13, 1996, six days after being shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Influence
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed in 1996. His lyrics and legacy continue to resonate.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon on this day in 1970. His guitar changed the world.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and its famous album cover.

angles.name: Iconic album cover
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That zebra crossing photo is still one of the most iconic album covers ever, isn't it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Hynde's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975, becoming an anthem for peace and hope.

angles.name: Imagine impact
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released in the UK. Its message of peace is as powerful today as ever.

events.title: First iPod anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: Tech game-changer
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? On this day in 2001, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Time to rewatch a classic, or debate your favourite Bond. Licence to thrill, eh?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the extraordinary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy legend. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album classic
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What are your standout tracks?
